Step 1: unplug the heater, light, filter Step 2: siphon the substrate/ground Step 3: drain approx. 1/3 of the water  Step 4: dechlorinate the fresh water and fill up the aquarium Step 5: wipe the rim, edges, outside of the tank Step 6: feed your betta and show them some love. A healthy aquarium doesn’t need to be spotless. It needs to be balanced. 🐠🌿 Comment AQUA and I’ll send you a link to this Aquarium + 20% off💧 One of the biggest things I’ve learned with aquarium care is that cleaning doesn’t mean disrupting the entire environment. For this maintenance, I removed some items that needed a little attention, then changed about half of the water out while leaving my fish comfortably in their established environment. I replaced the filter, treated the fresh water before adding it back, and slowly replenished what I removed before returning everything to its place. And something important to remember 🤗 much of the beneficial bacteria that helps support your aquarium lives within the filtration system and on surfaces throughout the tank, not simply in the water itself. That’s why I try to clean intentionally rather than scrubbing everything at once🌿🐠  the goal isn’t perfection, it’s happy, healthy fish 🐠🤎  #biophilicdesign #plantdecor #indoorjungle #biophilia #homedecor  HOW TO DESIGN YOUR HOME WITH PLANTS | HOUSEPLANT CARE | BIOPHILIC DESIGN | MOSS DECOR
